name: no-upload
description: Blocks commands that upload files to external services like pastebins and file-sharing sites.

allowHosts.title: Allowed hosts
allowHosts.description: Comma-separated hosts uploads may go to: example.com allows it and its subdomains, *.example.com only its subdomains. localhost and private network addresses are always allowed.

allowWord.title: Approval word
allowWord.description: When your latest prompt contains this word, uploads are allowed for that prompt. Leave empty to rely on the allowed hosts alone.
